scope: Exactly one review per case and instruction version, six calls. No hints, player calls, revisions, card execution or rerolls. All sessions fresh and independent. Before version is the 679-word NEW reviewer from the prior comparison, not the older 240-word reviewer.
inputControl: Both versions use byte-identical UTF-8 JSON input and output schema. Parsed payload values equal the prior fixed cases; Unicode escaping now fixed.

predeclaredRubric.late-club: Revise should identify CT as avoidable loss and C5 as feasible improvement from public history. Criticizing only explanation does not count.
predeclaredRubric.incomplete-initial: Revise for absence of a meaningful complete initial route, rather than inventing false card facts.
predeclaredRubric.reasonable-alternative: No blocking finding solely because a third-round hold-up is preferred. Evaluate any other evidence-supported finding independently.

caseOrigin.late-club: Exact historical public snapshot and corrected-explanation candidate, decision0021 attempt01. No hidden defender hands or offline proof supplied.
caseOrigin.incomplete-initial: Synthetic omission case on original 3NT snapshot. Candidate reduced to immediate card plus vague develop-and-cash instruction.
caseOrigin.reasonable-alternative: Synthetic reasonable-strategy control on original 3NT. Only changes hold-up from third round to second round and corresponding explanation; explicitly acknowledges communications risk.
